In [92]:

Out[92]:
<Axes: xlabel='acousticness', ylabel='instrumentalness'>
In [34]:
# There's a very weak correlation (0.104) between acousticness and instrumentalness.
# This makes sense conceptually: acousticness measures whether real instruments 
# are used, while instrumentalness measures the absence of vocals — a song can be 
# acoustic with vocals (singer-songwriter) or instrumental and fully electronic (EDM).
# The two features are largely independent of each other.
